name: Rummel & Rabalder: Jakten på Kapten Hanssons Guld
storyline:
The game is based on the TV show, and your goal is to collect as many cheese puffs as possible while flying through different worlds on a carpet.

After a failed experiment in Dr. Frank's laboratory Rabalder manages to understand Captain Hansson from his gold. But before Rabalder has time to repair Captain Hansson, Bråddisarna snatches the gold and slips away. To save the captain's life, Rummel and Rabalder travel with their flying carpet on a dangerous journey through the valves, out into the city, and through a winding ravine, all the way to the Treasure Hunt's treasure hideout.
summary: "Rummel & Rabalder: The Hunt for Captain Hansson's Gold" is a Swedish computer game from 1998 produced by Utero Digital Media AB , based on an idea by Lars Anttinen. The game is based on TV4 's characters Rummel and Rabalder from the TV series of the same name by Lattjo Lajban , created by Torbjörn Jansson , who also wrote the script for the game.
